statement: In public works, complementary works (trabalhos complementares) are works of a kind or quantity not in the contract that are needed to carry it out (Article 370 of the Public Contracts Code); they are approved by the owner, usually by an addendum, within legal limits.
details: Log every requested complementary work as a Change with its price basis (contract prices where they exist). The Court of Auditors noted that complementary works cannot be offset against works not done. Source is an opinion article; confirm against the consolidated Code.

statement: Construction companies need an alvará issued by IMPIC under Law 41/2015 to carry out construction works; its class caps the value of works the company may take.
details: Before levelling quotes, check each contractor's alvará and class against the value of the works. Class thresholds are set by ordinance (Portaria 212/2022 per secondary sources) and change; check the current one.

statement: A valid energy certificate (SCE, Decree-Law 101-D/2020) is required to sell or let a building or unit, with listed exemptions; certificates are issued by experts registered with ADENE.
details: Add the certificate to every property dossier and sales milestone. Source is secondary press; confirm exemptions in the consolidated decree.

statement: IMT (property transfer tax) rates and brackets are updated yearly; an IMT assessment remains valid for two years.
details: Agents must not quote an IMT bracket without the current table. Secondary sources disagree on thresholds because they come from different years.

statement: Since Simplex Urbanístico 2.0, a property transaction must state expressly whether a permit (title for the use) exists, or the deed can be annulled.
details: Add permit status to every property dossier and to the checklist before a promissory contract or deed. Source summarises the decree; a solicitador or notary confirms the wording needed.

statement: Price revision (revisão de preços) in Portuguese construction contracts follows Decree-Law 6/2004, in force with amendments (last in 2021); for public works, Article 382 of the Public Contracts Code makes ordinary revision mandatory.
details: When a claim includes revision, check the method and formula the contract names (Article 5 of Decree-Law 6/2004) and the base month (the month before the tender deadline in public works). Private contracts apply it only if the contract says so.

statement: Under Simplex Urbanístico, technicians and developers bear more responsibility for compliance, through the statements of responsibility (termos de responsabilidade) they sign, while municipalities control more after the fact.
details: Keep the evidence behind every signed statement in the decision log: the requirement, the drawings and calculations relied on, and who approved them. This is the architect pack's responsibility evidence file.

statement: Decree-Law 108/2026 (Simplex Urbanístico 2.0), published 29 May 2026, revised the urban development legal regime (RJUE) and entered into force on 3 August 2026; it reduces prior control and shortens procedures.
details: Applies to new procedures and to pending files still at an early stage. Check which regime a project's licensing file is under before planning permit milestones.

statement: Stamp duty (Imposto do Selo) of 0.8% applies to property purchases, on the same base as IMT; both are paid before the deed.
details: Include both IMT and stamp duty in acquisition budgets. IMT brackets change every year; always take them from the current table on the Portal das Finanças, never from memory.

statement: Mainland Portugal's standard VAT (IVA) rate is 23%. A 6% rate (List I, item 2.23 of the VAT Code) applies to building rehabilitation works in urban rehabilitation areas; the Supreme Administrative Court's uniformizing ruling 3/2026 narrowed when it applies.
details:
Agents state the IVA rate and the reason for it on every amount. Never apply 6% on a project's say-so: flag it for the contabilista, because ruling 3/2026 (Diário da República, 17 March 2026) may require an approved urban rehabilitation operation.
The source is a Tax Authority binding ruling on item 2.23 after Lei 56/2023.
